item.title: Meta rolls out its personal AI agent Muse to UK adults to help with everyday tasks, the first AI agent product launched by a Big Tech company in the UK (Mizy Clifton/Politico)
item.description:
Mizy Clifton / Politico:
Meta rolls out its personal AI agent Muse to UK adults to help with everyday tasks, the first AI agent product launched by a Big Tech company in the UK  —  Regulators will be watching the U.K. rollout of Muse carefully.  —  LONDON — Meta rolled out its personal AI agent Muse to the U.K. adults on Tuesday …

item.title: Novartis CEO and Anthropic board member Vas Narasimhan doubts AI will cure cancer in 5-10 years, arguing tech's "engineering mindset" overlooks human biology (Financial Times)
item.description:
Financial Times:
Novartis CEO and Anthropic board member Vas Narasimhan doubts AI will cure cancer in 5-10 years, arguing tech's “engineering mindset” overlooks human biology  —  Comments from pharma CEO follow ambitious claims from Anthropic chief and DeepMind founder

item.title: OpenRouter removes Together AI, Phala, and Novita over data policy violations; Novita says a misconfiguration sent some MiniMax requests to MiniMax official API (Bill Toulas/BleepingComputer)
item.description:
Bill Toulas / BleepingComputer:
OpenRouter removes Together AI, Phala, and Novita over data policy violations; Novita says a misconfiguration sent some MiniMax requests to MiniMax official API  —  OpenRouter removed three AI providers from its platform after discovering that they had violated their stated data-handling policies and exposed sensitive data.

item.title: PM Lawrence Wong says he doesn't want Singapore used to circumvent US chip export controls, as authorities probe Megaspeed's purchases of Nvidia chips (Philip Heijmans/Bloomberg)
item.description:
